title: Excellent Guided Alhambra Tour
text: It was a very enjoyable experience visiting the Alhambra with Ana as our guide. She was very informative and knowledgeable about all parts of the Alhambra and it was a very easy pace. We covered a lot of ground during our 3 hour tour. The meeting point was easy to find. Recommend booking with City Wonders and definitely recommend Ana as a guide.

title: Everyone knows the...
text: Everyone knows the Alhambra is a must visit when you’re in Granada, but I would really recommend joining a guided tour. This is a small group tour and there’re 8 of us which is the perfect size. Our guide Cristina del Arbol Maroto is such a knowledgeable and sweet lady. She told us many stories and history regarding the Alhambra and Granada. All the little details that really elevate the experience. The pace was just right too. We’re given time to take photos and it never felt rushed. Highly recommended!
author: Cherry_L

title: Highly recommended experience!
text: We absolutely loved our guided tour of the Alhambra. Everything was well-organized, and our guide, Gustavo, was fantastic—very knowledgeable and engaging. It was an incredible experience and we highly recommend both the tour and Gustavo to anyone visiting!
